Move the red car (AA) to the exit on the right.
Specify moves in the format: 'F+1 K+1 M-1 C+3 H+2 ...'
where the letter is the vehicle and +/- number is spaces to move right/left or down/up.
Walls are marked with an 'x'. Cars cannot move through walls, and walls cannot be moved.
A car oriented vertically can only move up and down, a car oriented horizontally can only move left and right.

Board:
..F.BB
..FCCC
AAFGHI
EDDGHI
E....J
....xJ


When you are done, put your final answer between <answer> and </answer> tags.

**Strategy:** Clear the path by moving each blocker out of row 2.

|------|------|-----------|
| 1 | E+1 | E moves down to free col 0, row 3 (allows D to shift left) |
| 2 | D-1 | D moves left to free col 2, row 3 (allows F to drop) |
| 3 | F+3 | F drops 3 rows, clearing col 2 from row 2 |
| 4 | C-1 | C shifts left (col 2 now free), freeing col 5, row 1 |
| 5 | I-1 | I moves up (col 5, row 1 now free), clearing col 5, row 2 |
| 6 | H+1 | H drops down, clearing col 4, row 2 |
| 7 | G+1 | G drops down, clearing col 3, row 2 |
| 8 | A+4 | A slides right to the exit! |

<answer>E+1 D-1 F+3 C-1 I-1 H+1 G+1 A+4</answer>
